items.title: Three equivalent formulations of flatness of a sheaf on the fibres of a morphism of algebraic spaces
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes the equivalence of three descriptions of flatness of F on the fibres of X -> Z over a point x: one through a geometric point and the fibre of the local ring, one through a K-rational point and the fibre product, and one through an etale chart U, V, W with a point u. The proof first shows that a chart as in (3) always exists by successive surjective etale choices, then passes to a common refinement using a geometric point lifting along the etale map U -> X, identifies the strict henselisations O_{X,x} = O_{U,u}^{sh} and likewise for Y and Z, and finally chases a chain of equivalences relating flatness of F at x over Y to flatness of the pulled-back sheaf on the fibre over w. The non-routine content is the transport of the flatness condition across the strict henselisation identifications and the final chain of equivalences, not any single step. Retained author proof at lines 5665-5787.
